scope: C0 only: sandboxed python3_script plugin runtime, capability registry, enable/disable/revoke/re-approve, Qt Plugins section, packaged bundled-CPython plugin runtime. No LLM, Model Manager, network, screen, mouse, keyboard or microphone capability.
review_fixes: Request-line bound raised to 16 KiB for capability_invoke applied to all lines and broke the A0 oversize check; now only JSON-object-looking lines may exceed 4 KiB, capped at 16 KiB, and only capability_invoke is accepted beyond 4 KiB (regression test added).
bwrap root was writable; added --remount-ro / (found by the Rust sandbox tests).
Revoked-but-installed plugins could not be re-approved; approve/permissions_approved now cover status installed, with Core and Qt tests.
ignored_coverage: Six argv-only dummy_evil modes (ignore_cancel, crash, bad_json, oversize, dup_id, log_flood) are unreachable through the Core by design; the same behaviours are proven by tests/plugins.rs with real sandboxed processes (cancel_is_honored_and_ignored_cancel_is_killed_and_restarted_once, crash_restarts_once_then_fails, output_violations_fail_plugin_and_are_never_trusted, log_flood_is_rate_limited_into_few_core_events). cpu_spin (40 s) not run.
limitations: exec of read-only /usr binaries is allowed inside the plugin sandbox (no network, no home, read-only root); no seccomp filter yet.
Payload is re-verified before spawn but bound by path, not by fd: a residual TOCTOU window exists; hub-plugins/ is 0700 and unreachable from the plugin.
RLIMIT_NPROC is the uid task count at spawn plus 16 (a fixed small value would stop bwrap itself).
prlimit binary required; spawn fails closed without it.
One package version exercised in the C0 package gate; plugin update/rollback pruning is covered by Rust tests, not by the process gate (only one C0 catalog).
Plugin errors surface as plugin_error (plugin code not echoed); plugin_log events carry no text.
Wake replay only; physical audio/KDE Wayland/Flatpak not validated; publisher unauthenticated.
Plugins cannot be enabled by anyone but the user via Core IPC/Qt; no auto-enable on install.
